map.📚 深度解析：证件照一键裁剪（一寸/二寸/护照规格）: 📚 In-depth analysis: one-click ID photo cropping (one inch / two inches / passport sizes)
map.简历、签证、考试报名需要合规证件照尺寸，手动裁容易不达标。: Resumes, visas and exam sign-ups need compliant ID photo sizes, and cropping by hand often misses the mark.
map.换底色（红/蓝/白）又不想重拍，用工具替换背景色。: You want a different background colour (red/blue/white) without a retake, so replace the background colour with a tool.
map.二寸和护照尺寸一样吗？: Are the two-inch and passport sizes the same?
map.照片比例与规格不一致时，用「完整留白」把整张照片放进规格框，四周填充指定的红/蓝: When the photo ratio differs from the spec, use Fit with margins to place the whole photo inside the frame and fill the surrounding area with the chosen red/blue/white background.
map.在预览图上按住拖动可平移取景；滚轮或滑杆缩放。取景只影响裁剪填满模式。: Press and drag on the preview to pan the framing; scroll wheel or slider to zoom. Framing only affects crop-to-fill mode.
map.选「护照」预设 390×567px（33×48mm @300DPI），完整留白: Pick the passport preset at 390×567px (33×48mm at 300DPI), use fit-with-margins plus a blue background; some countries also require a specific head ratio, so check the rules before applying.
map.不一样。二寸 413×579（35×49mm@300DPI），护照 390×56: No. Two inches is 413×579 (35×49mm at 300DPI) while the passport is 390×567 (33×48mm at 300DPI); check the requirements and pick the matching preset.
map.选「一寸」预设，按 25×35mm、300DPI 对应的 295×413px 居: Pick the one-inch preset and center-crop to 295×413px, the 25×35mm size at 300DPI; pixels are rounded from mm ÷ 25.4 × 300, so still verify the application system’s pixel or millimetre requirement.
map.像素 = 毫米 ÷ 25.4 × 300。一寸 25×35mm → 295×41: Pixels = mm ÷ 25.4 × 300. One inch 25×35mm → 295×413px; two inches 35×49mm → 413×579px; passport 33×48mm → 390×567px. Presets use these conversions instead of the old 258×335, 413×531 and 354×472.
